thoughts: A little love lives here ♡
You make ordinary days feel special.
A tiny hug, just for my princess.
Your softness is a kind of magic.
One little squish, one little smile.
A little palace, a whole lot of love.
You are my favorite part of today.
There is always a cozy place for you here.
Today's quest: be kind to yourself.
A little sparkle follows you around.
Sending a pocket-sized hug.
Let's make another lovely memory.
You deserve soft days and happy surprises.
My favorite room is wherever you are.
A princess deserves a little rest.
A tiny cheer for everything you do.
A little coffee date would be lovely.
You are loved on the quiet days too.
Collecting happy moments with you.
May today be gentle with you.
Espurr brought a little sparkle for your day.
Your tiny companion is cheering you on.
A little wiggle, a big happy heart.
There is a headpat waiting whenever you need one.
A soft paw and a cozy little hello.
Your palace is happier when you visit.
